description: Compiles the whole Part 5 legacy system (draft/part05) in one connection: FLDREF/FLDREFR, then the two display files, then the RPG III programs (TK0100 after TK0100D; ZA0500/ZA0510 need ZAIKOM/JUCHUD/JUCHUM/FLDREFR from TXSETUP, already in the target library; ZA0510 also /COPYs FLDREFR at compile time, so its file step must land in QRPGSRC before ZA0510's own CRTRPGPGM step, same ordering already satisfied by FLDREFR's existing early file step), then the CL programs (MN0000C after MN0000D; JU0900C DCLFs JUCHUM). Prerequisite: TXSETUP has already built the sample DB in this library, and this manifest's 'file' steps assume src/legacy/ exists in this git working tree (draft/part05 checked out) at run time - run `node verify/run.mjs part05-legacy-probe` from that branch, not main. Does not run any of the compiled programs (no CALL steps): interactive ones (TK0100, MN0000C) cannot be exercised over SSH anyway, running JU0900C/ZA0500 together is exactly the ticket-1 bug rehearsal (better done as its own deliberate step once compiles are confirmed clean), and ZA0510's own lesson (05-04) is explicitly a debugger-trace (STRDBG, interactive) exercise, not a non-interactive CALL/compare. Also compiles JUBADD (src/legacy/qddssrc/jubadd.pf) and C0511S (src/qclsrc/c0511s.clp) - 05-11's decimal-data-error teaching tool, not part of the old system itself, hence not under src/legacy/ - but no CALL step for C0511S either, since it deliberately writes a corrupted row into JUCHUD and this manifest has no cleanup/TXRESET step of its own. Two diagnostic steps (VDBR/VOBJ) round out the connection at no extra cost: DSPDBR FILE(&LIB/JUCHUM) and DSPOBJD OBJ(&LIB/*ALL) OBJTYPE(*PGM), both to OUTPUT(*OUTFILE) in this same library, followed by collect steps that dump their real column names/types and a few sample rows. This settles tools/qclsrc/txmigr.clp's own UNVERIFIED note about whether its assumed field names (WHFILE/WHLIB, ODOBNM/ODOBAT) are real, and specifically whether WHFILE/WHLIB name the dependent logical file or the physical file DSPDBR was run against - see the header comment TXMIGR's own DLTF-removal fix (tools/qclsrc/txmigr.clp) added about this being unverified and potentially destructive if wrong.

steps.label: CPFLDRF
steps.cmd:
DLTF FILE(&LIB/FLDREF)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTPF FILE(&LIB/FLDREF) SRCFILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(FLDREF)

steps.label: CPJUBAD
steps.cmd:
DLTF FILE(&LIB/JUBADD)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTPF FILE(&LIB/JUBADD) SRCFILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(JUBADD)

steps.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, LENGTH FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA = '&LIB' AND SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME = 'VFYDBR' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFYDBR FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, LENGTH FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA = '&LIB' AND SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME = 'VFYOBJ' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFYOBJ FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
